name: OpenClaw
description:
Connect Cortex XSOAR to OpenClaw, an open-source self-hosted AI agent gateway.
This pack provides the OpenClaw integration, which lets a playbook send an
instruction together with incident data to an agent and read the reply straight
back into the playbook context, start a fire-and-forget agent run whose answer is
delivered to a chat channel, post a system event to the agent's session, or
invoke a single OpenClaw tool without a full agent turn.
author: Nicholas Hsiao
